== Original Virtual Set 11 published English card text ==
The remaster removes the opponent’s 2 Force cost when the starfighter is at a battleground. It adds a once-per-turn Diversionary Tactics search and requires Executor to be with this starfighter at the end of the battle to draw destruction destiny.
